newsitem.title: CYPRUS: RATE ON 91-DAY CYPRUS BILLS FALLS TO 5.36 PCT.
newsitem.headline: RATE ON 91-DAY CYPRUS BILLS FALLS TO 5.36 PCT.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus sold 27 million pounds worth ($49.3 million) of 91-day treasury bills by auction on Wednesday at an average yield of 5.36 percent from 5.42 percent at the previous auction on July 23.
The bills have an August 13 issue date.

The central bank said it received bids totalling 56.5 million pounds for up to 27 million pounds worth on offer. Competitive bids accepted totalled 23 million pounds and non-competitive bids four million pounds.
Yields ranged from 5.41 percent to 5.30 percent.
